stepBody: Suppose we fit the following linear regression models to predict $$\text{total}.$$ Based on the data and visualizations shown, determine whether the fitted model weights are positive, negative, or exactly $$0$$. The notation $$\text{meat=beef}$$ refers to the one hot encoded $$\text{meat}$$ column with value $$1$$ if the original value in the $$\text{meat}$$ column was beef and $$0$$ otherwise.##figure9.gif##
